methodology.summary: Valuation gets 70% of the rank. A minimum quality and coverage floor removes the weakest balance sheets.
paragraphs: Pure Value Portfolio is constructed only from the existing Stockmonk US coverage universe. Intended investment horizon: 3-5 years. Every selected company passed the strategy's sector, size, liquidity and score-coverage screens.

Eligible US-listed companies are ranked with the Stockmonk four-factor scores: Growth 10% · Quality 10% · Valuation 70% · Technical 10%. Valuation gets 70% of the rank. A minimum quality and coverage floor removes the weakest balance sheets.  The highest-ranked names are selected subject to a 6% single-stock cap and a 30% sector guide. Weights use score-proportional sizing. The portfolio is reviewed quarterly.

No ETF, mutual fund or non-US-listed security is eligible. Missing data is not filled with an estimate. A company without a full research report remains eligible only where the quantitative strategy calls for it, and its constituent card links to score evidence rather than a research report.
The performance shown is a current-constituent simulation, not a live track record. Rebalancing proposals are generated from the same rules and remain proposed until a future review is executed.
